reviews.author: Gordon Wheeler
reviews.text: How can one visit Hong Kong and not get roast goose? Goose is apparently the thing in Hong Kong. Our hotel staff recommended Kam's, and we decided to give it a shot. Turns out they have Michelin ⭐. There was a bit of a wait, you go in

reviews.author: Khay Kid Chow
reviews.text: Kam's Roast Goose gives you the HK roast goose experience, from the mandatory queuing, hustle and bustle of HK eatery and great food. The roast goose was flavourful. There is a nice mixture of multiple tastes in every part of the goose as

reviews.author: Mick T
reviews.text: I really wanted to love Kam's Roast Goose, but the experience was a massive letdown. While the food is "decent," it certainly doesn't justify the logistical nightmare and the lack of respect for sit-down diners.

reviews.author: Kong Wen Sheng
reviews.text: 28 June 2026- It was raining and we decided not to take the cable car up the Peak tram now. We took a taxi over and explored this Central-Mid level escalators. Very interesting to link up majority of this area with escalators. We just

reviews.author: Nitin Subhash
reviews.text: The Central–Mid-Levels Escalator is a unique Hong Kong experience, an 800-meter covered ride through bustling streets, linking Central to the Mid-Levels. It's both practical and fun, offering glimpses of cafés, shops, and local life along the way. A quirky urban adventure worth trying.

reviews.author: Daphne Partridge
reviews.text: Take the escalators the walk a little higher (look out for small brown signs) and suddenly you're at the Tai Kwun: revitalized colonial police station and prison complex wbich has been transformed into a cultural heritage and arts

reviews.author: Angus Stew Pitt
reviews.text: Great collection of toys and you can literally find anything you need from here. The branch is located on the ground floor (G/F) of Ocean Terminal in Harbour City.

reviews.author: Mallika Jamy
reviews.text: My kids were so excited to see Toys R Us as it's their favourite place. Sadly the store in Pune India shut down and now they can't shop in their happy place. I was happy to see different toys which otherwise we don't get to see, I landed

reviews.author: Hungry Paaji
reviews.text: Amazing king size toys r us store at harbour city mall in TST. One gets hands on all the global toy brands and entertainment brands for the kids and teens, bit not just limited to them 😉. Also it has amazing individual experience spots for various brands.

reviews.author: Colin Leung
reviews.text: Worth paying the extra few dollars to see the very top of the Victoria Peak. Breathtaking views. Go on good weathered days to see the furthest. Go up between 8-10am to beat the crowds! Much more relaxing and enjoyable.

reviews.author: Ajay M
reviews.text: The Peak Tram experience was one of the highlights of our Hong Kong trip! 🚋🏙️ The place was quite crowded when we visited, and interestingly, we saw a lot of Indian tourists enjoying the experience too. 🇮🇳

reviews.author: akhil shanbhag
reviews.text: Best views of Hong Kong. Make sure you go on a day when the weather forecast is sunny - otherwise it’ll be waste of money. You can stay for as long as you like, though it gets quite windy. Dress appropriately. Lots of restaurants and souvenir shops.

reviews.author: Gajendra S
reviews.text: I found this place accidentally. I had some leisure time and went to the Kowloon Park and kept walking and reached here. Amazing time and experience. Most of the tourists never reach here so more peaceful. The area is calm, you get time to enjoy beauty of the skyscrapers. Definitely recommended place to have some quiet personal time.

reviews.author: Tere Wong
reviews.text: A hidden gem at the end of Ocean Terminal! 海運觀點 offers one of the best panoramic views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong Island skyline—perfect for soaking in the sea breeze and snapping stunning photos. The unobstructed vantage point

reviews.author: Jinjuta P.
reviews.text: Viewpoints are on upper levels 4F-6F. Took the escalator in the mall or park your car and walk just less than 5 min. Stunning view. Not too busy on saturday of July. No raining luckily. Quite romantic

reviews.author: Doug Ho
reviews.text: The Former Kowloon-Canton Railway Clock Tower, officially named the Clock Tower, is located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong. It is a prominent, iconic landmark near the Victoria Harbour waterfront and the Star Ferry Pier. The

reviews.author: Ato Chavez
reviews.text: If it’s your first time in Hong Kong, you cannot miss the Tsim Sha Tsui Clock Tower. It’s a beautiful piece of history made of classic red brick and granite. It sits right next to the Victoria Harbour waterfront, making it the perfect spot

reviews.author: Orathai Boonrossak
reviews.text: The Former Kowloon-Canton Railway Clock Tower is one of Hong Kong’s most important historical landmarks, standing proudly along the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront. Built in 1915, this red-brick clock tower is all that remains of the original

reviews.author: Breanna
reviews.text: It's cool and aesthetic, but not really much more aside from that. It was very quiet on the day that we went. Please ensure you bring your own ball as there are none for public use. One of the nets was out of action. Overall it was cool and definitely worth checking out.

reviews.author: Bent Zent
reviews.text: An iconic photo spot that also happens to be a public and free basketball court. Part of the public housing estate and complex, you'll find the courts at the top of the stairs from the carpark. Unless you're there to play, it's just a nice photo stop with the colourfully designed courts and surrounding apartments.

reviews.author: Diya Patel
reviews.text: loved the court so colorful best to go early on around 10 am during the weekdays if you want photos

reviews.author: Rae Zyon
reviews.text: A nice spot to take the famous monster buidling photos, quiet area on the ground level courtyard. There are some cafes and shops around for visitors.

reviews.author: Gustavo Orellana
reviews.text: The Monster Building is absolutely worth a visit if you're in Hong Kong. It's one of those places that really makes you stop and think, the dense, towering architecture is both impressive and a bit shocking, giving a real glimpse into how locals live in such compact spaces. It's also an incredibly photogenic spot, every corner looks straight out of a movie, and it's perfect for anyone into urban photography or looking for that iconic Instagram shot. Despite being a residential area, it's a respectful and eye-opening stop that captures the essence of old Hong Kong living. Definitely worth the trip and highly recommended for travelers who want to …

reviews.author: ChristianZ
reviews.text: It's an obviously iconic building complex and seeing it in person is awe inspiring. It's another face of Hong Kong some people don't get to see but you can certainly feel the history behind it. Just be respectful of the locals who live there and you should be ok.

reviews.author: Flo G
reviews.text: A wonderful spot for that panoramic Hong Kong view instead of the Peak Galleria with a sea of people. Easy hike flat trail for around 15-20 minutes to the end. Came by during sunset peak to catch sun setting and the night views. Coming here by bus 15 was a little challenging with full buses and winding exciting drives up the peak!! Do allow more time to get up here and down. Long snaking bus queues await going back to central. However buses came quite quickly which was a consolation. Still a worthwhile easy trail …

reviews.author: YL Wong
reviews.text: Nice peaceful walking trail, away from the tourist trap. This nicely paved road is loop, so u can walk clockwise or anti clockwise direction. Along the way, it's mostly shaded by the trees, can take rest & enjoy the beautiful view along the way… (vs the very crowded pagoda spot at the tram station) Set aside 1hr for this loop.

reviews.author: Rae Zyon
reviews.text: The place to get the best panoramic view of the Hong Kong city skyline, especially at night. It's a little crowded as it's a well known spot, the road from The Peak Tower is paved and smooth albeit dark at some spots. Pretty safe even at night.

reviews.author: Yan W
reviews.text: 1881 Heritage is a stunning destination! It served as the Hong Kong Marine Police Headquarters until 1996, and today it beautifully preserves its historical architecture and artifacts. The entire plaza looks absolutely magical when lit up at night. Now housing luxury boutiques, fine dining, and upscale bars, it is the perfect outdoor shopping spot if you are looking to treat yourself to high-end items.

reviews.author: Joseph Chow
reviews.text: This historical place was situated near the ferry pier and the bus terminal.  Visitors were welcomed free of charge. It was previously a marine police headquarter and also one of the weather observatories.  The facilities were well maintained but some escalators and stairway were closed.  Part of the platform with nice decorations was arranged for marriage celebration.  The view from the upper level was still attractive.  High-end  retail stores were operating in the place.  The point was worth a visit.

reviews.author: yoyo yiu
reviews.text:
It is a full of vintage and historical atmosphere!
The dinning is very nice with many professional cookers!
I Enjoy all in 1881!
Remember to bring your selfi stand to take more photos! I suggest all wear the vintage and elegant dessing!

reviews.author: The Fox's Trails
reviews.text: Stopped by a couple of times when catching the Ferry back or forth. Not on the same level as let's say Chicken Egg Boy, but a decent offering.

reviews.author: Michelle Yau
reviews.text: I recommend this brand for eggs waffles & waffles no matter the locations in Hong Kong as a local! The quality of food from these brand keeps very good which I have tried 4-5 shops in Hong Kong already.

reviews.author: Alvin Choo
reviews.text: These egg waffles were really decent! They have a QR code for online ordering and you get your items fresh in 10 minutes.

reviews.author: How Ying Lai
reviews.text: The original Tim Ho Wan in Sham Shui Po (I haven’t tried the Mong Kok branch) deserves its Michelin star. This branch, however, feels like it’s riding on the popularity of the name. The pineapple bun arrived lukewarm, while the siew mai was

reviews.author: S D
reviews.text: It is a little tricky to find the store as you have to take a “separate escalator” to get to the restaurant.

reviews.author: Ronald Po
reviews.text: Conveniently located in the High Speed Rail Station, this Tim Ho Wan is perfect for a pre-travel bite. While it lacks the grit of the original, it offers cleaner, spacious seating and shorter queues. The signature Baked BBQ Pork Buns remain essential—crispy, sweet, and consistently excellent. Fast and reliable.

reviews.author: Daniel NG
reviews.text: 主要食乳鸽，有多款口味和煮法，如红燒乳鸽，盐焗乳鸽，香茅蒸乳鸽，黑松露鸽饭，鸽珍饭，等等

reviews.author: 小小玩家
reviews.text: 排队不到一个小时就吃到了，太好吃了，爆汁。

reviews.author: waishi chung
reviews.text: 大鸽饭是我到中国南部必吃的，从来不会让我失望。

reviews.author: Leonie
reviews.text: 出品丰富，不只越南菜系、泰式、马来风味，粤菜、川菜照样有，所以就算fusion餐馆吧。点了越式春卷和综合牛肉pho，味道的正宗与好吃，属于正常平均水准。倒是菜量很大，显得性价比蛮高的。

reviews.author: Ye H
reviews.text: 美味的香肠帕尼尼佐以美味的番茄酱。附近的大教堂，有点绕，但非常值得！

reviews.author: xinxian kongqi
reviews.text: 经济实惠、饭食可口

reviews.author: Poh Sah Teo (Steven san)
reviews.text: 非常不错的甜品

reviews.author: steven lim
reviews.text: 真是个美好而甜蜜的夜晚结尾。晚上8点半的时候餐厅并不拥挤，我们很快就找到了座位。

reviews.author: Queen Lillian
reviews.text: 姜汁撞奶，口感划算，椰汁陶胶红豆冷，但不是太冰也不会太甜陶胶不会太烂给予肯定，榴梿班戢榴梿味香浓十足也不会太甜，感觉好像可以再点一个芒果试试。北京路步行街甜品店推荐。
